## Change

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. For financial or ownership behavior, identify the regression scenario and distinguish local/Sandbox evidence from confirmed testnet transactions.

## Evidence and limits

Include relevant UI captures or public receipt references. State anything that remains untested or depends on an external provider. Keep credentials, private artifacts and raw env files out of the PR.
